descripcion: At A2 you introduce the present perfect for life experience (I've been to Paris) and keep the past simple for finished time (I went there in 2019). The finer rules come at B1. This is the first step towards more precise time reference at higher levels.

ejemplos.texto: I went there in 2019 with my family.

notas: Have/has + been to is a very common pattern for experience.
A specific past date or time word (in 2019, last year) needs the past simple.
When always takes the past simple.

contraste.es: En muchas variantes del español latinoamericano se prefiere el pretérito indefinido incluso para experiencias, así que el present perfect inglés puede sentirse poco natural al principio.

errores: Using the present perfect with a specific past date.
Using the past simple for general life experience.
autochequeo: Is the present perfect used for experience, without a specific date?
Is the past simple used with a specific time?
Is the past simple used after when?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on present perfect versus past simple. Check whether a specific time word forces the past simple. Do not rewrite the text. Flag any confusion between the two.
